meta.source: docs/CleanOps-界面设计指南.md, the FastAPI enums it documents, and a Mobbin review of Jobber, Xero, Stripe, Airwallex, Mercury, Deel, Sentry and Laravel Cloud

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The page ground. Every screen sits on it; cards float above it on surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, the top bar. The default ground for content and for ink.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card: metric cells, read-only fields, table zebra if you ever need it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Overlays only: dialog, popover, dropdown, command palette. Pair with shadow-overlay.

tokens.name: row-hover
tokens.usage: A table row under the pointer or keyboard focus. Quieter than surface-sunken so a hovered row never looks selected.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a dialog. The page stays visible so the person remembers what they are confirming.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: The navigation column and the settings sub-nav: one step greyer than bg, so chrome reads as chrome and the white cards read as content (Stripe, Mercury, Linear all do this).

tokens.name: sidebar-active
tokens.usage: The selected nav item's ground. A filled row, not a brand-coloured bar: the brand is spent on actions, not on where you are.

tokens.name: sidebar-hover
tokens.usage: A nav item under the pointer.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on bg, surface and surface-sunken. 13.9:1 on surface in light.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, secondary values. 4.9:1 on surface: the darkest grey you may use for 12px text.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Secondary metadata with sufficient contrast on content surfaces; important business values use ink.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on brand, ok, warn-strong and bad fills. Never on a tint surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card and table borders, dividers. This system separates with lines, not shadows.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders, so a field reads as editable. 3:1 against surface.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring, 2px offset 2px. Never remove it; every row and action is keyboard reachable.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary actions, the active nav item, links, in-progress state. White 13px text on it clears 4.5:1.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed for anything filled with brand.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: brand-surface
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the plan pill, quiet brand emphasis. Text on it is ink or brand, never brand-ink.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Paid, delivered, approved, connected. As text on surface or ok-surface.

tokens.name: ok-surface
tokens.usage: The ground of a success badge or banner.

tokens.name: ok-line
tokens.usage: The border of a success banner.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Waiting on a person: unconfirmed, pending review, closing soon, unread.

tokens.name: warn-surface
tokens.usage: The ground of a warning badge or banner.

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: The border of a warning banner.

tokens.name: warn-fill
tokens.usage: A warning as a filled shape: a meter at its limit, a progress bar about to run out. Never text; always beside a label that says At limit.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Bounced, void, overdue, failed, refused. The only red in the system.

tokens.name: bad-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed for the destructive button.

tokens.name: bad-surface
tokens.usage: The ground of the bounce banner and the read-only banner.

tokens.name: bad-line
tokens.usage: The border of a destructive banner or metric cell.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral state: issued, sent, scheduled, under review. Never for success.

tokens.name: info-surface
tokens.usage: The ground of an informational badge or banner.

tokens.name: info-line
tokens.usage: The border of an informational banner.

tokens.name: console-brand
tokens.usage: The operations console only (§151). It must never look like a tenant's own screen.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Series slot 1: the series the chart is about — invoiced, work hours, completed jobs. The brand hue stepped into the chart band (the brand token itself reads grey at chart chroma in light). Validated with slots 2–4: every check passes in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Series slot 2: the comparison series — paid, travel hours. Always in this order after slot 1; never skip a slot.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Series slot 3. Scatter-type charts stop at three series; in dark those three sit at CVD ΔE 7.4, so they need direct labels.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Series slot 4, for bars and lines only. Past four series, fold the rest into Other or split into small multiples; never add a hue.

tokens.name: chart-muted
tokens.usage: De-emphasis and Other: the rest of the series when one is the point, last period behind this one.

tokens.name: chart-neg
tokens.usage: The negative pole of a diverging chart — a job that lost money. The positive pole is chart-1. Not the bad status token: a pole, not an alarm.

tokens.name: chart-mid
tokens.usage: The neutral midpoint of a diverging scale, and a meter's empty track.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines: solid 1px, one step off the surface. The axis baseline uses line-strong.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Prose: guidance, banner copy, empty states.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: The default. Tables, forms, everything dense.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: The value half of a label-and-value pair; a row's primary column.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Sidebar group labels, table headers, the small uppercase-free eyebrow above a title. ink-muted.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metric labels, helper text, timestamps. Only in ink-muted or a signal ink.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen, in the PageHeader. 24px matches what Stripe, Mercury and Airwallex use for a list or record title.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: A card or block inside a detail page: Line items, Activity, Details; a settings section.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: A tile or card header. Deliberately smaller than body: the number is the hero.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: The dashboard and report metric. Proportional figures: equal-width digits look loose at this size.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: An invoice total on a detail page, beside its lines: tabular, so it lines up with them.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Money and hours inside a table row. Tabular numerals, right aligned.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Invoice numbers, ids, request_id, tokens in logs. Never for prose.

spacing.note: A 4 grid. Card padding is space-4 dense or space-6 roomy; the dashboard grid gap is space-5; page padding is space-8.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons; the gap in a metric cell.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside a table cell; between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Dense card padding; the gap between metric cells.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: The dashboard grid gap; card padding on a detail page.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a card; roomy form padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page padding, and between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Above a page title, and between the shell and a centred empty state.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, the tag on a nav item, skeleton bars. Matches shadcn's rounded-sm step.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, nav items, banners, metric cells. shadcn's rounded-md; the 10px it replaced read as consumer-soft next to Stripe and Xero.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, dialogs, toasts, the table frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Counts only: the unread dot, a number beside a nav item, avatars. Statuses are not pills (see StatusBadge).

shadow.note: Content separates with line. Two shadows exist: a hairline lift under controls you can press, and the overlay shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Secondary and primary buttons, inputs, the segmented control. The shadcn shadow-xs: enough to say pressable, not enough to say floating.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialog, popover, dropdown, toast, command palette.

size.note: Control and row heights. A dense office tool lives or dies on these.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Inline control in a table row.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: The default button, input and select.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: A screen's primary action, and any control a banner carries.

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: The minimum tap target on the field app and on any phone layout.

tokens.name: touch-lg
tokens.usage: The field app's full-width primary action in the bottom ActionBar: the one button a gloved thumb has to hit first time.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Table row, the default. Fifteen rows must fit an office screen.

tokens.name: row-two-line
tokens.usage: A row whose cells carry a second line: customer plus contact email, due date plus "in 7 days". Airwallex and Deel lists.

tokens.name: row-comfortable
tokens.usage: Table row when the viewer asks for it; remember the choice per viewer.

tokens.name: announcement
tokens.usage: The full-width strip above the top bar: trial days left, read-only account. One at a time.

tokens.name: topbar
tokens.usage: The top bar. 64px wasted a row of table on a laptop; Stripe and Mercury sit at 52–56.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: The navigation column, expanded.

tokens.name: rail-collapsed
tokens.usage: The icon-only rail below 1280px, and when the person collapses it.

tokens.name: dialog
tokens.usage: Confirm and short-form dialogs. Anything wider is a page or a sheet.

tokens.name: form
tokens.usage: The maximum width of a form or settings column. Tables take the full width.
